root_cause.text: The `ionic_create_cq()` function declares a local `struct ionic_cq_resp resp` without zero-initialization, causing uninitialized stack memory in the `rsvd[7]` field (always) and potentially in the `cqid[1]` field (when `udma_mask` has only one bit set) to be copied to userspace, resulting in a kernel stack information leak.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message describes the structure layout, noting that `rsvd[7]` is never set and `cqid[1]` may be skipped by the loop, and the fix is to initialize `resp` with `= {}`.
